items.title: 68356_Howard R. Scott oral history interview
items.q: Do you remember any of the women who were in Mrs. Henderson's band, when she had her all-girl orchestra? Marie Lucas was one.

ctx.x: Yeah, well, when Dutch Schultz was there we got $200 apiece. That was just tips that night. Those guys -- and when they came around and asked Alley -- of course, we knew everything they'd call popular songs. We knew all them. Do you know so-and-so? Alley would say, certainly, and we'd play for them.
